I needed bloodtests and had been told ( by reception) that there was no possibility for some time, so I had to wait. Once I had seen the physician (face to face) and got the ok for the bloodtests, I had to wait again for the tests. 
I am very satisfied with the physician and technician (or nurse?) who was in charge of the bloodtest, the results came in fast and a call to make another appointment to discuss these, came fast too. 
However, now I have to wait again for the phone call with physician to discuss some results. So all in all, I have been waiting for about a month and a half for a simple bloodtest.
